blocks.text:
After breakfast, begin the journey to the Caribbean coast.

The drive to Bocas del Toro takes about 4 hours.

Continue with a private boat transfer.

Colón is the archipelago’s main island; accommodation is at Azul Paradise Bastimentos Island Punta Vieja.

The archipelago has many small islands, mangrove lagoons and short boat routes.

Colourful wooden houses, piers and small waterfront establishments are typical of the area.

Stay at Azul Paradise Bastimentos Island Punta Vieja.

blocks.text:
The entire day is free.

Relax beside the Caribbean Sea or choose optional activities independently.

Snorkelling and discovering the marine environment are the main activities here.

In the clear water, you may see coral reefs, starfish, sponges, tropical fish and small rays.

Sea turtles may also be seen.

The water is darker in the quieter mangrove lagoons.

Dolphins sometimes appear near the islands.

There is no scheduled sightseeing programme for this day.
